product.name: Regular-Fit Lightweight Bomber Jacket
product.description: Lightweight, regular-fit bomber jacket in woven fabric with a comfortable, classic silhouette. Ribbed stand-up collar, zipper at front, side pockets with zipper, and an inner pocket with zipper. Wide ribbing at cuffs and hem. Lined.
